title: Do Political Opinions Transfer Between Western Languages? An Analysis of Unaligned and Aligned Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting multilingual LLMs to report their agreement or disagreement with political statements from voting advice applications (ProbVAA) and analyzing the generated stances on specific policy issues, alongside evaluating open-ended opinionated summaries.

Comparing the political opinions expressed by models across five Western languages (English, German, French, Spanish, and Italian) to assess whether opinions transfer cross-lingually or reflect language-specific socio-cultural differences.
